case.summary: A transaction of $35.66 was flagged by a real-time model with a score of 0.76. The device profile was new for the account, but only 8% of past alerts with that signal were fraud, so it pointed to a genuine customer. The bank model’s score was considered a weak input because scores above 0.7 are usually legitimate, and the customer confirmed the purchase through a one-time passcode on their registered phone. The case was closed as legitimate and the transaction was allowed. No further action is required.
